notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.content: [h1][b]Hi everyone![/b] [/h1][p]I just released a [b]brand new[/b] demo as well as a new trailer. I would love for you to go try it out and see if you can beat it.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Complete graphical overhaul with newer, better graphics and detail,[/p][/*][*][p]New NPC to meet and with a quest to complete his mission for a small reward,[/p][/*][*][p]New tutorial area to ease players into the controls better,[/p][/*][*][p]Dedicated speedrun-mode that unlocks after beating the demo,[/p][/*][*][p]Save system to store player progression between play sessions,[/p][/*][*][p]More graphics options to tweak (resolutions, v-sync, target framerate etc.),[/p][/*][*][p]And a bunch more small quality-of-life features..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you encounter any bugs/issues, feel free to join the Discord (link down below) and provide more details. Much appreciated 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]Other than that, I hope you enjoy![/p][previewyoutube="zJ5SM6TumEY;full"][/previewyoutube]
